metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the `ical` CLI in Node.js (no dependencies) under `output/`.

- Entry point: `output/main.js`
- Subcommands:
  - `node output/main.js parse --input <path.ics> --output <out.json>`
  - `node output/main.js expand --input <path.ics> --from <YYYY-MM-DD|...Z> --to <YYYY-MM-DD|...Z> --output <out.json>`

Key files:
- `output/ics.js`: RFC 5545 content-line parsing (unfolding, parameters, nesting) + `line_too_long` / RFC 6868 parameter unescape warnings
- `output/components.js`: schema mapping for VCALENDAR/VEVENT/VTODO/VJOURNAL/VFREEBUSY/VTIMEZONE/VALARM/VAVAILABILITY(+AVAILABLE) and `expand` recurrence+override logic
- `output/rrule.js`: RRULE parsing + BYxxx expansion/filters + BYSETPOS
- `output/timezone.js`: VTIMEZONE parsing + local↔UTC conversion with fold/gap warnings
- `output/values.js`, `output/text.js`, `output/errors.js`, `output/warnings.js`: shared utilities and error/warning plumbing
